parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The username.

- Pass the real name of the employee.
- If not specified, the system uses the name corresponding to the current userId for booking
parameters.help_zh:
用户名称。

- 建议传入员工真实姓名；
- 不传则会以系统当前维护 userId 对应的名称进行预订
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The department ID.
- If not specified, the system retrieves the department information based on the user information.
- Ensure that the correct department ID is passed. Otherwise, the cost attribution of the employee's travel expenses may be affected.
- The department ID must be numeric
parameters.help_zh:
部门 ID。
- 如果不传，会根据 user 相关信息去获取对应的部门信息；
- 请确保传入正确的部门 ID，否则会影响员工差旅费用归属；
- 部门 ID 只能是数字
parameters.name: depart_id

parameters.help_en: The department name
parameters.name: depart_name

parameters.help_en:
The third-party department ID.
- Specify either the third-party department ID or the department ID.
- If both are specified, the third-party department ID takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:

- 三方部门 ID 和部门 ID 传入一个即可。
- 若三方部门 ID 和部门 ID 均传值时，将以三方部门 ID 为准

element_fields.help_en:
The departure and arrival city names.
- Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas
element_fields.help_zh:
离抵城市名称。
- 多个城市请用中文逗号隔开
element_fields.name: city_set

element_fields.help_en:
The departure and arrival city codes, separated by Chinese commas.
- When set to 0, city restrictions are not enforced. Ensure that hotel travel standards are passed for all cities.
- When `traffic_type` is set to 0/6/21/25, you can pass either an airport three-letter code or a six-digit city code. For other enum values, pass a six-digit city code.
- The `city_set` and `city_code_set` values must correspond one-to-one.

><warning>When `traffic_type` includes flight, if the specified city has no airport, flight tickets cannot be booked.></warning>

> Business travel city data:
> - [Airport three-letter code data](https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx);
> - [Six-digit city code data](https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
element_fields.help_zh:
离抵城市code，多个城市请用中文“，”隔开。
- 传0时，不管控城市。使用时，请注意酒店差标的传参，确保所有城市都有传入差标。
- 当交通方式 `traffic_type` 传入 0/6/21/25 时，可传机场三字码或城市六位码。其他枚举值请传城市六位码。
- 离抵城市 `city_set` 和离抵城市code `city_code_set` 必须一对一。

><warning>当交通方式 `traffic_type` 包含飞机时，如果给到的城市无机场，则不可预订机票。></warning>

> 商旅城市数据：
> - [机场三字码数据](https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)；
> - [城市六字码数据](https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)

parameters.help_en:
The domestic hotel budget.
- Currency unit: CNY, in cents.

><warning>Miscellaneous charges incurred by specially authorized guests during their stay (such as meals and in-room products) are deducted at checkout and paid by the enterprise.></warning>

国内酒店预算。
- 货币单位：人民币，分。

><warning>特殊授权人住店产生的杂费（用餐、房间内商品等）将在退房时扣款，由企业支付。></warning>

- Currency unit: CNY, in cents

国内机票预算。
- 货币单位：人民币，分
parameters.name: flight_budget

parameters.help_en:
The train ticket budget.
- Currency unit: CNY, in cents.

><warning>For example, when the seat class is "hard sleeper", upper/middle/lower berths have different prices. The budget balance is validated against the highest price.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
火车票预算。
- 货币单位：人民币，分。

><warning>例如坐席同为”硬卧“，上/中/下铺存在价格差异的情况，预订时将按照其中最高价格，校验预算余额。></warning>
parameters.name: train_budget

parameters.help_en:
The car service budget.
- Currency unit: CNY, in cents.

> Ride-hailing scenarios involve uncontrollable factors that may exceed the original estimated price:
> - The passenger changes the destination offline.
> - Traffic congestion or other road incidents. 
> - The driver adds surcharges such as tolls, highway fees, or waiting fees
parameters.help_zh:
用车预算。
- 货币单位：人民币，分。

> 打车场景存在不可控因素，会超出原预估价格。
> - 乘客线下修改目的地；
> - 堵车等道路意外情况； 
> -  司机添加附加费，如过路费、高速费、等待费等
parameters.name: vehicle_budget

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
- When calling the API over HTTP, this parameter is **required** and must be appended to the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the token, see [Enterprise access token](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
- When appending the token, you can use any of the following formats: `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. We recommend using `corp_token=value`

- 在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
